children: Jefferies raised the model weight for Reliance Industries GDR (RELIANCE) to 7.5% on Oct 6, 2026, citing an implied 8.4x one‑year forward EV/EBITDA and upside from earnings upgrades and higher GRMs.
Motilal Oswal reaffirmed Buy on Reliance Industries GDR (RELIANCE) with a ₹1,530 target, citing the proposed Jio Platforms IPO as a potential catalyst for telecom and digital visibility.
Banks including Kotak, Morgan Stanley, BofA, Axis, BNP Paribas and Citi named lead managers for Jio Platforms share sale tied to Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (RELIANCE).
RELIANCE to invest Rs 1 lakh crore in Andhra Pradesh CBG plants using agri residue, dung and food waste; project aims to create 300,000+ jobs and generate ~Rs 60,000 crore in state revenue.
RELIANCE signed a 15‑year green ammonia supply deal with Samsung C&T in Mar 2026. Deliveries start H2 FY2029. Contract value: over $3 billion.
RELIANCE owns 66.4% of Jio Platforms. Analysts say a Jio listing may face a holding-company discount; Motilal Oswal estimates the market already prices an 18–36% discount.
Delhi High Court allowed Reliance (RELIANCE) to keep marketing Campa drinks as "energy drinks" after Reliance Consumer Products Ltd challenged FSSAI’s June 30 ban.
Court set next hearing for Nov 5 in case involving Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (RELIANCE). Court questioned why FSSAI didn’t issue a notice before its June 30 order.
RELIANCE via Reliance Consumer Products is expanding the Campa Cola plant in Hooghly, West Bengal; bhoomipujan set for Oct 26.
